## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Lahupāvuraṇa-sikkhāpada* ("Getting an expensive light cloak in exchange"), classified as Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12 (Bi-Vb Np12), is an ecclesiastical rule belonging to the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule stipulates that a nun who requests or obtains an excessively expensive, light outer-robe in exchange must forfeit the robe and confess the offense. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
